_: English, the reference catalog: every other catalog has exactly these keys. See "Translations" in CLAUDE.md. Keys starting with _ are notes, not text.

summary.none: No full pomodoro this time. That's fine.
summary.parent_confirm: That was the last subtask of “{parent}”. Complete it too?
summary.task_gone: That task is no longer in the list.

today.empty: Pick a task. 25 minutes, just that.

general.language_help: The language of buZyist's text, dates and numbers. Saving a new one reloads the windows.

stats._: The Stats tab (Settings). Day names and numbers come from formatDate/formatNumber.

focus.title: Focus

chart.one: Focus per day over the last {n} day: {duration} in all.
chart.other: Focus per day over the last {n} days: {duration} in all.

focus.activities_empty: Pick an activity under “What are you working on?” to see where your focus goes.
focus.tasks_empty: No pomodoros yet. Pick a task and start the timer.
focus.help: Focus time counts finished pomodoros. Sessions count once they have a finished pomodoro; tasks worked on got at least one pomodoro, tasks done were completed in buZyist.

apps.title: Time in apps
apps.switch: Count the time I spend in each app

chart.one: Time in apps per day over the last {n} day: {duration} in all.
chart.other: Time in apps per day over the last {n} days: {duration} in all.

apps.apps_empty: Nothing counted yet. Use an app for a minute and come back.
apps.apps_off: Turn this on to see which apps get your time.
apps.sites_off: Turn this on to see which websites get your time.
apps.sites_empty: Nothing counted yet. Browse for a minute and come back.
apps.sites_no_extension: Websites are timed by the Chrome extension: set it up in the Websites tab.
apps.help: The app in front gets the time, in focus or not, unless you haven't touched the keyboard or mouse for a minute. Websites are timed by the Chrome extension: the active tab of the browser window you're in, so they are part of your browser's time above. It all stays on this PC, in app_time.json and site_time.json.

blocks.title: Websites blocked

chart.one: Blocks per day over the last {n} day: {focus} during focus, {limit} over a limit.
chart.other: Blocks per day over the last {n} days: {focus} during focus, {limit} over a limit.

blocks.empty: Nothing blocked yet. Turn on blocking in the Websites tab, or add a website limit.
blocks.help: Counted each time the Chrome extension shows its block page: during a work phase, or when a website limit is used up or in its blocked hours. Every browser profile on this PC adds to the same counts.

errors.language: Pick a language from the list.
